submitted.rationale: I measured EQE at five Sb fractions: 0.11 → -0.0014%, 0.27 → 0.0029%, 0.50 → 0.0038%, 0.57 → 0.0031%, 0.66 → 0.0030%. Signal is very low everywhere and peaks near Sb fraction 0.5 (BiSbO4 stoichiometry). XRD at 0.43, 0.50 and 0.57 is mostly FTO (SnO2 rutile) reflections, plus a minor phase near Q≈2.00 that fades as Sb increases. Index 22 had the highest measured EQE.

rejected.reason: EQE was negative, near noise; the Bi-rich region looks inactive
